input.quote: 13.5 SFJ Representation, Warranty and Covenant. SFJ hereby represents, warrants and covenants that it will have, as and when needed, sufficient funds to satisfy its obligations hereunder.
input.rationale: SFJ performs real work under this Agreement (it is sponsor in the SFJ Territory and conducts the Clinical Trials there), but its only warranty is the funding representation in § 13.5, and § 13.6.2 disclaims all warranties except those set out in Article 13. There is therefore no performance warranty and no warranty remedy, which fails the fallback on both elements. We add a short § 13.5.1 supplying only the fallback package — professional and workmanlike Services, 90-day software conformance to documentation, 30-day Services period measured from performance, with repair, replacement or refund — leaving § 13.5 and the mutual outcome disclaimer in § 13.6.1 (which benefits PB) untouched; the Article 13 carve-out in § 13.6.2 preserves the new warranty.

ops.text: SFJ Performance Warranty. SFJ warrants that (a) the Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner; (b) for 90 days following delivery, any software provided by SFJ will conform to its documentation; and (c) for 30 days following performance of the Services, the Services will conform to their documentation. PB's remedy for breach of this warranty is repair, replacement or refund of the amounts paid for the non-conforming software or Services.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] SFJ's only warranty is that it will have sufficient funds, so we added a short performance warranty for the work SFJ actually performs: professional and workmanlike Services, software conforming to its documentation for 90 days, Services for 30 days from performance, with repair, replacement or refund. This is our fallback position and § 13.6.2 already carves out Article 13 warranties from the disclaimer.
proposal.summary: Insert an SFJ performance warranty at § 13.5.1: professional and workmanlike Services, 90-day software conformance to documentation, 30-day Services period from performance, with repair, replacement or refund.
